svg.desc: Describe the app in the molecule.dev IDE, the mlcl CLI or any MCP agent, and Synthase assembles it from the open-source @molecule catalog. Every provider sits behind a swappable bond, so changing the database is one import, not a rewrite. Auth, payments, i18n, analytics, monitoring, tests and CI come wired in from day one. Built-in analytics, error tracking and feedback let the AI keep improving the app from real use. Faster, cheaper, higher-quality apps for web, mobile and API that stay easy to change.

g.text: Describe the app in the molecule.dev IDE, the mlcl CLI or any MCP agent, and Synthase
mlcl · the CLI, and an MCP server for any agent
It picks packages from their generated docs and wires them like

g.data-info: @molecule/api-ai — One AI interface with tools and streaming; Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Google and more as bonds.
@molecule/api-flights — Flight search, booking and status behind one interface; providers as bonds.
@molecule/api-ai-speech — Speech to text and text to speech, so the agent can listen and talk back.
@molecule/api-payments — Checkout, subscriptions and split bills; Stripe and others as bonds.
@molecule/api-sms — Texts and rebooking alerts through Twilio and others.
@molecule/app-react — The React binding: hooks for auth, i18n, theme and routing over framework-agnostic cores.
@molecule/app-analytics — Track once against the interface; wire Mixpanel, PostHog or your own.
@molecule/app-react-native — The same app on iOS and Android, with native device bonds.

g.text: API + app · compiles, tests pass, live preview
